notes.content:

Hello everyone, 

We're happy to share with you public channels on Discord App.
By joining us on Discord, you have the possibility to chat with the devs, participate to the Q/A of the assets and / or the game itself.
Don't miss the chance to be constantly updated about the state of the project ;)

For joining us on Discord that's simple, just click this [url=https://discord.gg/Mpcn4Rt]Invitation Link[/url] to access our channels.

See you there for more informations.

notes.title: Prism confirmed at E3 2016
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/fec9bede5dfe9f8b165c526b935c57e1ad0e0d4b.png[/img]

[h1]Prism gonna be present at [b]E3 2016, June 14-16[/b] on the stand of Budgames.[/h1]

Our stand number will be [b]2903[/b].

Our participation for the the E3 will be really an important moment for us and we hope to see many of you on our stand to live this great event together.

[i]A playable demo will be available there so don't hesitate to come say hi![/i]

[b]see you next week in L.A[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/db5baedbcbab59141298913b7bdea7fb1ea7ed98.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Back from Stunfest
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/2710667673c6dd65d1cfb90d194c7ff4f9ccc385.png[/img]


[h1]Last week we were presenting the last build of Prism at Rennes for the [b]Stunfest festival[/b] for its 12th edition![/h1]

So many amazing feedback this year again, and we want to say [i]Thank You[/i], to all people who came giving a try to our game.

We were also really suprised, but we won the [b]2nd place of the Great Audience Award[/b] of between the 39 other indie games who were present with us.

finally, we also gave an interview (in French) to Joypad, you can read it here


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/073a45dacb49ba5b92d2495f9ce61dd9a09d15d7.jpg[/img]

[url=http://joypad.fr/interview-video-prism-12-skills-to-shoot-them-all/]Joypad - interview with the developers[/url]

Now, we are engaging the next step of the production, and we will start soon to work on new levels, and enemies.

Stay tunned ! 

[b][u]Bonus : some pictures[/u][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/8afdd4747670db67f2ba603423003c22d7692d94.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/65dbf17e65d384f91b354f6de1018deda7e28a97.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/cbb692b3fc24f8eb985aa5ffa4bd751cb4795f7b.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25052317/a3db2d648f33b2c4aafdb9d212be897bdf553a6f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Prism to Stunfest 2016 in Rennes + New roadmap
notes.content:
[img]http://indie.stunfest.fr/static/images/assets/logo_2015.png[/img]

This year, we will meet you to the Stunfest 2016 at Rennes. We will have a stand in the indie zone.
Since the greenlight, it passed 1 entire year on adding new features in the game, and we encourage you to come and play to discover what is awesome now :)

[b]Finally you can find below the next planned roadmap for the development :[/b]
